name: Mindy
description:
Mindy is the AI business-development analyst for federal contractors. Ask in plain language and Mindy works the way a seasoned capture team does — reading live SAM.gov solicitations, identifying the incumbent and predecessor award, pulling GSA labor rates and SEC financials, finding capable teaming partners, and extracting the compliance matrix from an RFP.

It's grounded in real federal data, never generic AI: 317,000+ contractors, 88,000+ SAM opportunities, 125,000+ verified agency contacts, and 24,000+ contracts scanned nightly. Every figure traces to USASpending, SAM.gov, SEC EDGAR, GSA CALC, Grants.gov, or NIH RePORTER — so a number you cite in a proposal is one you can defend.

49 tools span the full pursuit: find your federal market, win the recompete, know who to call, and draft the winning proposal. Built by the people from GovCon Giants, who've helped tens of thousands of small and medium businesses break into government contracting.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Mindy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Mindy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.getmindy.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Mindy MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mindy lists 49 MCP tools, including add_contacts_to_crm, assess_market_depth, build_proposal_structure, derive_company_keywords, draft_proposal, draft_proposal_section, evaluate_bid_decision, export_proposal, extract_compliance_matrix, extract_statement_of_work, find_capable_contractors, and find_predecessor_award.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Mindy?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Mindy in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Mindy requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Mindy is developed by Govcon Giants. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
